# Max Pergola

> Max Pergola supplies factory-direct aluminum louvered pergola kits for residential and trade projects worldwide. Product pages lead with feet-and-inch dimensions and include metric references for drawings and production.

Current shipping: Max Pergola can quote factory-direct Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) delivery from Chongqing to supported destinations worldwide. The written project quote confirms the destination, included duties and taxes, unloading responsibility, route restrictions, pricing, design criteria, availability, and ship-from location. Regional inventory may supplement the factory route only when confirmed for the approved configuration.

## Products

- [Aluminum pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/): Compare seven nominal footprints from 10 × 10 ft through 13 × 19 ft; choose the roof package, layout, finish, and factory-prepared accessories; and create a configuration SKU for a written quote.
- [Louvered pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/louvered/): Compare manual and motorized aluminum louvers, adjustable shade, integrated drainage, lighting preparation, and project scope.
- [Freestanding pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/freestanding/): Plan a four-post layout around furniture, foundations, anchors, wind exposure, drainage, and roof controls.
- [Attached pergola kits](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/attached/): Coordinate the house structure, wall connection, flashing, drainage, outer-post foundations, and written scope boundaries.
- [Pergola on deck guide](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/deck/): Verify deck framing, supports, footings, lateral load path, waterproofing, clearances, and drain discharge.
- [Best aluminum pergola kits buyer's guide](https://maxpergola.com/best-aluminum-pergola-kits/): Compare roof behavior, documents, drainage, finish, installation, delivery, warranty, and total project cost using one scorecard.
- [Standard manual pergola](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/standard/): 10 × 10 launch price $4,089; compare-at $5,841; manual louvers.
- [Pro motorized pergola](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/pro/): 10 × 10 launch price $5,034; compare-at $7,191; motorized louvers and perimeter LED preparation.
- [Max premium pergola](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-kits/max/): 10 × 10 launch price $7,239; compare-at $10,341; motorized louvers and louver-light preparation.

## Technical and warranty

- [Aluminum specifications and BOM](https://maxpergola.com/engineering/specifications/): 6063-T6 order design basis, current profile dimensions, wall thicknesses, and package BOM scope.
- [Wind, snow, and span calculator](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-calculator/): Location-specific preliminary load screening; not a structural approval or permit package.
- [Limited warranty](https://maxpergola.com/warranty/): 10 years for covered frame defects, 5 years for covered powder-coat defects, and 2 years for covered moving and electrical components.

## Planning guides

- [Pergola lighting ideas](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-lighting-ideas/): Ambient, task, accent, and circulation-light planning for dining, cooking, lounge, and walkway zones.
- [Pergola installation](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-installation/): Complete project scope from permits and foundations through frame, roof, electrical work, testing, and inspection.
- [Pergola cost guide](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-cost/): Budget the kit, delivery, unloading, foundations, labor, electrical work, permits, taxes, and inspections.
- [DIY pergola guide](https://maxpergola.com/diy-pergola/): Jobsite, footing, anchor, delivery, frame, louvered-roof, drainage, and final-inspection checklist.
- [Backyard pergola ideas](https://maxpergola.com/backyard-pergola-ideas/): Six residential layouts for outdoor dining, kitchens, pool decks, small patios, and evening lounges.
- [Pergola vs gazebo](https://maxpergola.com/pergola-vs-gazebo/): Comparison of roof type, shade control, rain coverage, footings, maintenance, and common backyard uses.
